name: graph_upsert_bug
title: graph.upsert_bug
description: Persist one bug and everything attached to it. Idempotent MERGE on natural keys, so a resumed run overwrites rather than duplicating. Bugs failing admission are stored with admitted=false and a reason — never deleted, or the dataset’s selection bias becomes invisible.

record.description: Full bug record: fix, hunks, symptom, reproducer, path, metrics, evidence refs.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.
